info.name: Oath of Ambition
info.description: Oath of Ambition paladin subclass — ATÉRIOR.
info.author: Falling-Cats

description.p: A paladin sworn to their own advancement, pursued by whatever means actually work — pirate queen, bandit warlord, or a knight who takes mercenary contracts to keep his own village fed.

An Oath of Ambition paladin has sworn themselves to exactly one thing: their own advancement, pursued relentlessly, by whatever means actually work. Nothing about that requires villainy, and nothing about it requires heroism either — this is simply the most honest Oath in the book about what it's actually for.
The Oath has no opinion on which. Every Bargain this paladin strikes is real and binding, whether it's a fortune in gold or a single frying pan that was never a fair trade to begin with.

sheet.description: A paladin sworn to their own advancement, pursued relentlessly, by whatever means actually work.

description.p: You've learned to formalize every exchange, however small. A Bargain is any agreement you strike, out loud and with a willing party, to perform a task in exchange for something of value — coin, favor, service, or an object neither side would call a fair trade. The Oath doesn't judge the terms, only that both sides agreed to them.
You can have only one Bargain active at a time. Striking a new one ends the previous, unfulfilled or not.

sheet.description: You can strike a Bargain: a formal agreement, out loud and with a willing party, to perform a task in exchange for something of value. Only one Bargain can be active at a time.

description.p: When you strike a formal agreement to perform a task in exchange for anything of value — coin, favor, or a frying pan, the Oath doesn't care how fair the trade actually was — you can expend a use of Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action to seal it, gaining temporary hit points equal to your Paladin level. A sealed Bargain stays active until fulfilled or willingly abandoned.

sheet.description: When you strike a formal agreement to perform a task in exchange for anything of value, you can expend a use of Channel Divinity to seal it, gaining temporary hit points equal to your Paladin level. A sealed Bargain stays active until fulfilled or willingly abandoned.

description.p: Within your Aura of Protection, you and your allies have advantage on Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion) checks.
While you have an active Bargain, you and your allies within your Aura add your Charisma modifier to damage rolls.

sheet.description: Within your Aura of Protection, you and your allies have advantage on Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion) checks. While you have an active Bargain, you and your allies within your Aura add your Charisma modifier to damage rolls.

description.p: While you have an active Bargain, immediately after a creature hits you with an attack, you can use your Reaction to make one melee attack against it, if it's within reach. On a hit, you can push it 10 feet away from you.

sheet.description: While you have an active Bargain, immediately after a creature hits you with an attack, you can make one melee attack against it if it's within reach. On a hit, you can push it 10 feet away from you.

description.p: As a Bonus Action, gain two of the following for 10 minutes (or until you end it early, free) — all four, if you have an active Bargain:
Charismatic. Advantage on all Charisma checks.
Unshakeable Terms. Once per turn, reroll a missed weapon attack.
Collect in Full. Regain hit points equal to your Charisma modifier whenever you reduce a creature to 0 hit points.
The Price of Crossing Me. Once per turn on a hit, force a Charisma saving throw (your spell save DC) or Frighten the target until the end of your next turn.
Once per Long Rest, or restore it by spending a 5th-level spell slot (no action required).

sheet.description: Gain two of the following for 10 minutes (all four with an active Bargain): Charismatic (advantage on Charisma checks), Unshakeable Terms (reroll a missed weapon attack once per turn), Collect in Full (regain HP equal to Charisma modifier on reducing a creature to 0 HP), or The Price of Crossing Me (once per turn on a hit, force a Charisma save or Frighten). Restore by spending a 5th-level spell slot.
